selection_scope.selection_rule: Select a small first-phase set with an explicit local contract, a bounded clean-room use, a named future adapter, or a recorded rejection.
selection_scope.copy_boundary: This registry stores provenance and local integration decisions only; it contains no upstream skill body or source code.

capabilities.why: The local orchestrator skill is the canonical director-facing entry and owns research fan-out.
capabilities.not_now: The upstream skill body and autonomous runtime loop are not imported.

capabilities.why: The local council already defines bounded cross-disciplinary roles and a falsifiable final chain.
capabilities.not_now: It remains advisory and cannot create results or establish novelty.

capabilities.why: The local module records fail-closed work orders, completions, blind packets, and content-quality evidence.
capabilities.not_now: The unlicensed upstream text and implementation are not copied or imported.

capabilities.why: A future adapter could bind paper claims to repository evidence under the existing repo-code-audit mode specification.
capabilities.not_now: There is no one-button recipe or admitted upstream runtime for this adapter.

capabilities.why: The local overlay binds claims to named results, uncertainty, limitations, and evidence locators.
capabilities.not_now: It cannot create results, strengthen evidence, or reward persuasive wording.

capabilities.why: The local manuscript-review recipe consumes frozen input and returns advisory review and rebuttal material.
capabilities.not_now: It does not submit a manuscript or make the director's venue decision.

capabilities.why: The local contract exposes a fail-closed read-only resource-status checklist with explicit freshness rules.
capabilities.not_now: Status query does not authorize job submission, cancellation, remote writes, or permission changes.

capabilities.why: The local recipe already uses a staged multi-perspective evidence panel and deterministic truth checks.
capabilities.not_now: The noncommercial upstream work is retained only as pinned conceptual provenance.

capabilities.why: The local review mode separates frozen authoring input from independent review and reconciliation.
capabilities.not_now: No upstream reviewer prose, rubric text, or runtime is embedded.

capabilities.why: The native trace module hash-binds sanitized blind packets and validates independent completion evidence.
capabilities.not_now: The contract does not claim model or provider independence without matching receipts.

capabilities.why: The local results-to-claim overlay requires evidence locators and keeps truth verdicts independent of rhetoric.
capabilities.not_now: This is an internal audit checklist, not an imported calibration implementation.

capabilities.why: The local council terminates in an explicit hypothesis, mechanism, and falsifiable-experiment chain.
capabilities.not_now: The council remains advisory and cannot turn an analogy into evidence.

capabilities.why: The local JSON schema independently validates typed council contributions and scientific boundaries.
capabilities.not_now: The upstream validator script is not imported or executed.

capabilities.why: The local bundle schema requires a reconciled mechanism and falsifiable final experiment boundary.
capabilities.not_now: The upstream prediction validator remains a provenance candidate, not a runtime dependency.

capabilities.why: The local overlay requires analysis unit, clustering, estimand, effect-size target, and a-priori rationale.
capabilities.not_now: The separate power-analysis-review mode remains specification-only.

capabilities.why: The local overlay defines the read-only DICOM identity, geometry, lineage, and split-leakage boundary an adapter must satisfy.
capabilities.not_now: No pydicom adapter, inventory script, or de-identification script has been admitted into the machine.

capabilities.why: The deterministic local router separates quantitative plots, scientific diagrams, and editable canvases with truth-aware status.
capabilities.not_now: Routing and QA metadata do not imply that a renderer or external backend exists.

capabilities.why: The local plot lane records source-data, uncertainty, readability, and caption-to-claim QA requirements.
capabilities.not_now: The unlicensed upstream figure instructions and implementation are not copied.

capabilities.why: A future pinned exporter could satisfy the existing quantitative-plot output and receipt contract.
capabilities.not_now: The upstream export script is not imported, and the local router is not a renderer.

capabilities.why: The editable-canvas lane already states the graph hash, pinned adapter, round-trip identity, and receipt boundary.
capabilities.not_now: No draw.io CLI, bundled vendor code, browser control, MCP connection, or latest-version installer is admitted.

capabilities.why: The source lock records the live-control surface as non-selectable.
capabilities.not_now: Live MCP or browser-control execution is outside the admitted offline visualization boundary.

capabilities.why: The local authoring mode can apply claim-bounded structure and method-expression checks to frozen evidence.
capabilities.not_now: No published asset, journal template, or source prose is copied.

capabilities.why: The local review mode separates contribution, validity, evidence, reproducibility, figure, ethics, and claim-calibration concerns.
capabilities.not_now: The rubric does not impersonate a journal reviewer or decide publication.

capabilities.why: The local visual router exposes figure-source, uncertainty, export-format, and caption-consistency checks.
capabilities.not_now: It does not reproduce house style or reuse published figures.

capabilities.why: The local statistical overlay requires analysis-unit, clustering, estimand, uncertainty, and sensitivity declarations.
capabilities.not_now: The rubric cannot choose a test from aesthetics or validate a post-hoc power claim.
